product.name: ErgoFlex Mesh Executive Chair
product.description: The ErgoFlex Mesh Executive Chair delivers a blend of comfort and support for long work sessions. Its breathable mesh back and padded seat reduce heat buildup, while adjustable armrests and height controls allow users to find a personalized posture. A lumbar support system and a 360‑degree swivel base provide stability and freedom of movement. The chair’s sturdy steel frame is finished in a subtle charcoal gray, complementing modern office interiors. Designed for durability, the seat can support up to 120 kg, making it suitable for a wide range of users.
